tagline: Leading manufacturer of specialty electronic components for innovative technologies in medtech, defense, industrial, and electrification markets
hero_kpi_rationale: The R&D KPI is the Hero because it reflects the company's deliberate and strategic investment in research and development, essential for developing custom engineered solutions and remaining competitive in the specialty semiconductor sector

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: The company's revenue increased by $39.7 million due to sales growth in targeted markets, notably a $28.9 million increase in the PD segment and $10.8 million in the MSA segment
kpis.signal: Revenue growth driven by sales expansion in medtech, defense, industrial, and electrification markets

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Company gross margin as a percentage of revenues
kpis.description: The company's gross margin increased to 43.2% compared to 42.4% in 2024, due to higher volumes, widespread cost reductions, improved capacity utilization, and higher prices in the PD segment, partially offset by unfavorable product mix and lower yields
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement driven by cost reductions, price increases, and better production capacity utilization

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.explanation: Company spending on research and development
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased by $0.7 million to $40.2 million in 2025, primarily due to increased development activities and incentive compensation. As a percentage of revenues, R&D decreased from 7.1% to 6.8% due to revenue growth
kpis.signal: Strategic R&D investment with 1.8% increase reflecting commitment to custom engineered solution development, partially offset by improved R&D to revenue ratio declining from 7.1% to 6.8%
